content.value_statement: Researchers need fast access to preprints that may not appear in journal indexes yet. This skill searches arXiv and returns concise paper titles, summaries, and links.
actual_capabilities: Searches arXiv using a natural language query.
Returns paper titles, abstracts, and direct arXiv links.
Lets users set the maximum number of papers to retrieve.
Sorts returned papers by relevance through the arXiv library.
Works without an arXiv API key.
limitations: Requires the Python arxiv package to be installed.
Searches arXiv only and does not query PubMed or journal databases.
Returned preprints may not be peer reviewed.
Results depend on arXiv availability and query wording.

use_cases.title: Find Current Research
use_cases.description: Search for recent preprints on a research topic before starting a literature review.

use_cases.title: Track Technical Methods
use_cases.description: Find papers about algorithms, models, or statistical methods related to active work.

use_cases.title: Gather Background Reading

best_practices: Use specific technical terms and include the target domain.
Start with fewer papers, then expand the result count if needed.
Verify important claims in the full paper before citing them.
anti_patterns: Do not treat arXiv preprints as peer-reviewed evidence.
Do not use vague one-word queries for specialized topics.
Do not assume arXiv covers all relevant biomedical literature.

faq.question: What does this skill search?
faq.answer: It searches the arXiv preprint repository for papers matching a query.

faq.question: Does it need an API key?
faq.answer: No. The skill uses public arXiv access and does not require authentication.

faq.question: Can I limit the number of results?
faq.answer: Yes. Use the max papers option to control how many papers are returned.

faq.question: Are the papers peer reviewed?
faq.answer: Not always. arXiv contains preprints, so users should verify publication status when needed.

faq.question: What fields are returned?
faq.answer: The skill returns each paper title, abstract summary, and direct arXiv link.

faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
